items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Lucky knew me so he asked me if I wanted a job and that's when I got it.

ctx.x: I was paying the lady about $10 a week, I think and didn't have no job, the musicians in New York would say, go on back to Boston, so around '25, the -- Lucky Roberts called me.
He was the great piano player we're talking about. He wrote that song.
